_about: Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), session 199. The inputs of the figures that docs/methods/datacenter_pays_algorithm.md quotes, as the page's files (site/data/datacenter) held them in the build of 2026-10-10T15:03:08Z: the default case alone (ERCOT, LZ_NORTH, bought in real time). index: the part of index.json read. months: each month of a flat load as site/lib/datacenter.ts monthsOf() gives it (flat is the sum of the hourly prices held, USD per MWh). years: the zone's hourly real-time and day-ahead prices of 2025 to 2026 in the page files' own shape (s is the first hour held, counted from the year's first hour in US Central standard time; v the prices from there, USD per MWh), and the day-ahead prices of the last 30 days of 2024.
